Electrodynamic tether.subject: Indian Architecture
Electrodynamic tether.question: The _____ was Long conducting wires which can act as electrical motors or generators.
Electrodynamic tether.fact: Electrodynamic tethers (EDTs) are long conducting wires, such as one deployed from a tether satellite, which can operate on electromagnetic principles as generators, by converting their kinetic energy to electrical energy, or as motors, converting electrical energy to kinetic energy. A number of missions have demonstrated electrodynamic tethers in space, most notably the TSS-1, TSS-1R, and Plasma Motor Generator (PMG) experiments.

Electrodynamic tether.subject: Indian Architecture
Electrodynamic tether.question: When direct current is applied to the tether, it exerts a _____ force against the magnetic field, and the tether exerts a force on the vehicle
Electrodynamic tether.fact: When direct current is applied to the tether, it exerts a Lorentz force against the magnetic field, and the tether exerts a force on the vehicle. Electrodynamic tethers exchange momentum with a planetary magnetosphere or ionosphere via Lorentz forces on a long current-carrying conductor, enabling drag or thrust without propellant in suitable environments (e.g., low Earth orbit).
